name: cellimo
description: Agentic, reproducible single-cell analysis in Marimo

interface.shortDescription: Agentic, reproducible single-cell analysis in Marimo
interface.longDescription: Cellimo gives Codex or Claude Code the scaffolding to do single-cell analysis in a live Marimo notebook: the experimental design is settled before any p-value is computed, every artifact carries SHA-256 lineage back to an immutable source dataset, and `cellimo check` refuses results that rest on pseudoreplication or batch-corrected values. Retrieval over published single-cell notebooks is read-only and citable.
defaultPrompt: Pair with my marimo notebook and take me through quality control
Audit this .h5ad and propose the experimental design
Review my analysis against its recorded provenance
